assumptions.statement: Undotted and dotted spinor spaces are distinct complex two-dimensional spaces; Lorentz indices have four components. Pauli and invariant tensors have commuting complex entries, independent of field statistics.
Preserve dottedness, variance, slot order and free signatures. Contract epsilon on its second slot for raising/lowering. A first-slot contraction adds a minus sign; dummy changes must avoid capture.

L and R are left/right Weyl representation matrices compatible with the sigma invariant and eta=(-,+,+,+). Covariance is considered in the connected proper orthochronous group and its spin cover, with inherited chapter34 representation conventions.

Retain terms linear in antisymmetric delta-omega_mu_nu in the expansion 1+(i/2)delta-omega_mu_nu S^mu nu; repeated antisymmetric Lorentz pairs are summed in this convention. Drop O(delta-omega^2) only when deriving first-order identities.

For the bilinear manipulations assume the indicated Weyl components are odd generators with anticommuting products. The printed (35.24) is used as an algebraic premise; it is not certified as an unrestricted unequal-time quantum-operator relation in every interacting or massive theory.

Hermitian conjugation is an antilinear order-reversing operation, interchanges dotted and undotted spinor types, and conjugates complex matrix entries. It does not by itself introduce a Grassmann swap sign.
Same-point field bilinears are formal composite expressions here. Operator domains, smearing, renormalization of products and a full spin-statistics theorem are outside the present source inventory.
Exercises35.2 and35.3 import (34.9),(34.10),(34.17). The imported statements were text-read on PDF234/235 (printed210/211); those prerequisite pages were not visually reviewed in this assignment.

Conditional inherited generator convention: S_L, S_R and S_V satisfy S^{mu nu}=-S^{nu mu}. Lowered delta-omega_mu_nu is antisymmetric with six independently variable entries mu<nu; the repeated ordered-pair sum in +(i/2)delta-omega*S counts both orders. Coefficient extraction is only at first order with O(delta-omega^2) discarded. These are premises for the source derivation, not a certified proof of generator antisymmetry.

Conditional source premise: the two-lower-undotted generator is symmetric in its spinor slots, as stated by srednicki:ch035:prose:p217-generator-symmetry-left following srednicki:ch035:equation:35.8. Use this named source result conditionally; no proof artifact or independent verification is supplied.

Conditional source premise: the two-lower-dotted generator is symmetric in its spinor slots, as stated by srednicki:ch035:prose:p217-generator-symmetry-right by the dotted analogue of epsilon invariance. Use this named source result conditionally; index typing alone does not establish it and no proof artifact is supplied.

Conditional source premise: the generator/sigma relation is exactly the ordered expression recorded by srednicki:ch035:equation:35.16, obtained in the source from srednicki:ch035:equation:35.15 using srednicki:ch035:equation:35.4. Projection consumes this relation, the appropriate lowered-generator symmetry and the ordered epsilon contraction. This names a derivation dependency, not an established theorem.

Conditional inherited chapter34 premises for srednicki:ch035:equation:35.28: the two left Weyl fields obey the same L field transformation at Lambda^-1 x; daggered fields obey the compatible conjugate/right Weyl transformation with explicit epsilon variance conversion and invariant sigma compatibility. U is invertible, implements the declared transformation by U^-1(.)U and this action respects products and the antilinear order-reversing adjoint. In a Hilbert-space realization require U dagger=U^-1 on a common invariant domain; no such realization, domain theorem or prerequisite proof is certified here. These inherited field/adjoint premises are distinct from checking finite sigma matrices.

conventions.statement: Chapter35 local convention pending F04 normalization: eta=g=diag(-1,+1,+1,+1); epsilon^12=epsilon^(dot1 dot2)=epsilon_21=epsilon_(dot2 dot1)=+1, epsilon^21=epsilon^(dot2 dot1)=epsilon_12=epsilon_(dot1 dot2)=-1, diagonal epsilon entries zero. Raise/lower by contracting epsilon second slot. sigma^mu_(a dota)=(I,Pauli1,Pauli2,Pauli3); barsigma^(mu dota a)=epsilon^(ab) epsilon^(dota dotb) sigma^mu_(b dotb)=(I,-Pauli1,-Pauli2,-Pauli3). Suppressed undotted contraction is upper-then-lower, chi^a psi_a; suppressed dotted contraction is lower-then-upper, chi-dagger_dota psi-dagger^dota. Left-handed fields are written without daggers, right-handed fields as daggers. Lorentz generator expansion uses +(i/2)delta-omega*S. The mixed-index S_R in (35.22) has FIRST dotted index upper and SECOND lower, unlike the lower-upper S_R in (35.12); epsilon conversions must be explicit. Existing Rust context uses Clifford=-2eta, not +2eta; Clifford is not needed to state this chapter.
